title: Find the Length of a String Without Using strlen()

blocks.content: Find the Length of a String Without Using strlen()
We know that we can find the length of a string using the strlen() function. However, in this example, we will find the length of a string without using strlen().
We know that every string ends with the null character, '\0'. Now, we can use a loop that runs until the '\0' character is encountered.
In this way, we can access every character and once we know how many characters are present, we can find the length.
In the above example, the while loop runs until the character of text at index length is '\0'. This way we can count each character and hence the length.
